reader_summary.headline: Episode explores how art dealer Joseph Duveen built a massive business connecting European art with American wealth.
reader_summary.overview: Joseph Duveen connected European art collections with wealthy American buyers to build a massive business. He held valuable inventory for decades because it appreciated in value, similar to long-term stock investing. The episode compares his strategy to buying great businesses that compound value over time.

thesis: The episode discusses the biography of Joseph Duveen, a legendary art dealer who connected European art with American wealth. The speakers highlight Duveen's business model of selling art to Americans, his intense salesmanship, and his practice of charging high prices followed by generous spending on clients.
